title: Extensions
hint: Extensions add pages, panels, actions and columns to Sextant. Each one runs in an isolated frame and can reach your clusters only through the permissions you give it when you install it.

host.failedUnknown: the extension stopped with an error

openUrl.title: Open a link?
openUrl.text: Extension {{extension}} wants to open this address in your browser:

openCluster.title: Open a cluster?
openCluster.text: Extension {{extension}} wants to open the cluster at {{address}}. Sextant connects it if it is not connected.

signIn.title: Sign in to {{service}}
signIn.text: Extension {{extension}} asks you to sign in (namespace {{namespace}}).
signIn.hint: Sextant keeps what you type and sends it only to this service; the extension never sees it. Remembered sign-ins are kept in your system's keyring.

action.timedOut: {{action}} did not finish within 2 minutes and was stopped.

install.folderTitle: Choose the folder of an extension

url.title: Install from URL
url.label: Link to a file in a GitHub release
url.hint: Only links of the form https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/releases/download/<tag>/<file> are accepted. The file may be up to 20 MB. Nothing is installed until you agree to the permissions.
url.invalid: This is not a link to a file in a GitHub release.

errors.conflict: Another extension with this id is already installed
errors.notFound: This install is no longer available
errors.unreachable: The file could not be downloaded
errors.other: The extension could not be installed

consent.author: Author
consent.devHint: It runs straight from this folder, and changes to its files are picked up while Sextant is open. It is marked Development.
consent.newPermissionsHint: This version asks for more than you allowed before. Read the permissions below.
consent.samePermissionsHint: This version asks for nothing new.
consent.reviewHint: The files of this extension now ask for more than you allowed. It stays paused until you agree.
consent.noContributions: Nothing is added to the interface.
consent.secretWarningHint: This extension asks to read Secret values: passwords, tokens and keys. Allow it only if you trust its author.
consent.namesake: The catalog lists an extension with this id: {{name}} by {{author}}. This package is not from the catalog.

contributes.kinds: Kinds in a section of its own

permissions.clustersNote: A name covers every cluster context with that name, from every kubeconfig source.
permissions.none: No access to the data of any cluster.

secretValues.all: Can read the values of Secrets in all namespaces
secretValues.in_one: Can read the values of Secrets in the namespace {{names}}
secretValues.in_other: Can read the values of Secrets in the namespaces {{names}}

permissions.clusterWide: Objects that belong to no namespace (such as Nodes) are covered only by rules for all namespaces.
permissions.readGroups: May read every kind of the API groups under {{groups}}, in every namespace.
permissions.statusPatches: May change the status of: {{kinds}} (where it may modify them).

list.failed: The list of extensions could not be read
list.pausedHint: This extension asks for more than you allowed. It is paused until you review its permissions.
list.actionFailed: The change could not be made

reinstall.file: To review its permissions, install it again from the file {{name}} (Install from file…).
reinstall.url: To review its permissions, install it again from {{url}} (Install from URL…).
reinstall.catalog: To review its permissions, install it again from the catalog.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: The extension, its files and the data it stored are deleted from this computer. Your clusters are not changed.

notice.text_one: {{names}} asks for more permissions than you allowed and is paused.
notice.text_other: {{names}} ask for more permissions than you allowed and are paused.

activity.title: Extension activity
activity.hint: What extensions asked for. Values of secrets, YAML and command output are not recorded.
activity.failed: The log could not be read
activity.clearBody: All recorded calls of extensions are deleted from this computer.

catalog.useHint: Sextant reads the list of extensions from github.com/FriendsOfKubernetes/sextant-extensions when you open the catalog, or this page while an extension from the catalog is installed, at most once an hour. Turned off, Sextant asks nothing.
catalog.trust: The catalog says who publishes each extension, and Sextant checks that the package you install is signed by them. The catalog does not review the code of every release: an extension may still do only what you allow on the next screen.
catalog.failed: The catalog could not be read
catalog.staleNote: Showing the copy from {{date}}: the catalog could not be refreshed ({{message}}).
catalog.newerFormat: This catalog is written for a newer Sextant. Update Sextant to browse it.
catalog.empty: The catalog lists no extensions yet.
catalog.noMatch: No extension in the catalog matches.
catalog.skipped_one: {{count}} entry of the catalog could not be read and is not shown.
catalog.skipped_other: {{count}} entries of the catalog could not be read and are not shown.
catalog.asPublished: As published in the catalog. The install screen shows what the package itself asks for.
catalog.permissionsUnreadable: This Sextant cannot show the permissions the catalog lists.
catalog.newerNeedsSextant: This Sextant installs version {{version}}. Version {{newer}} needs a newer Sextant.

catalogStatus.updateAvailable: Version {{version}} is available in the catalog.
catalogStatus.updateAvailableNewer: Version {{version}} is available in the catalog. Version {{newer}} needs a newer Sextant.
catalogStatus.needsNewerSextant: Version {{version}} in the catalog needs a newer Sextant.
catalogStatus.keyChanged: The publisher's key changed in the catalog, so updates are refused. To trust the new key, remove the extension and install it again.
catalogStatus.repositoryChanged: The publisher's repository changed in the catalog, so updates are refused. To trust it, remove the extension and install it again.
catalogStatus.withdrawn: Withdrawn from the catalog: {{reason}}. Consider disabling or removing it.
catalogStatus.notListed: The catalog no longer lists this extension.

backend.heading: Code outside the window
backend.runsCode: Runs its own code outside the window
backend.runsCodeHint: Its backend is a WebAssembly program that Sextant runs in a sandbox. It reaches clusters only with the permissions above and the network only at the hosts below, and it cannot read files on your computer.
backend.hosts: It may send HTTPS requests to:
backend.noNetwork: It may not use the network.
backend.credentials: It asks for credentials that you enter in Sextant:
backend.credentialsHint: You enter them after installing, under Credentials in its row. Only this extension's backend can read them.
backend.credentialsIntro: Values are kept in your system's keyring. Only this extension's backend reads them, and Sextant never shows them again.

problems.heading: Problems and notifications
problems.kinds: Sextant checks objects of these kinds by the extension's rules, lists what they find on the Problems page and may notify you about it:
problems.kindsFrom: The kinds that objects of {{kind}} define (the API group at {{groupPath}}, the kinds at {{kindPaths}}), read from the first {{max}} of them by name
problems.lookups: To tell whether an object a rule names exists, Sextant also lists objects of these kinds:
problems.judges: The extension's backend decides some of these problems. It gets the objects of these kinds with only these fields, and while it decides it can reach neither the clusters nor the network:
problems.scope: Only in clusters and namespaces where the extension may read these kinds. No code of the extension runs for this.
problems.judgesScope: Only in clusters and namespaces where the extension may read these kinds. Sextant lists the problems and sends the notifications; besides its backend's decisions, no code of the extension runs for this.

metrics.heading: Metrics
metrics.queries: The extension may run these fixed queries in the Prometheus-compatible source of each cluster it may reach; it fills in only names and durations:
metrics.scope: Prometheus may answer with data of any namespace, including namespaces where the extension may not read objects.

commands.heading: Commands
commands.list: The extension may run these programs, never through a shell, filling in only the values its parameters allow:
commands.changes: Changes something: Sextant asks you every time. Runs in the container {{container}} of the newest ready pod with the labels {{selector}}.
commands.reads: Only reads. Runs in the container {{container}} of the newest ready pod with the labels {{selector}}.
commands.scope: Only in namespaces where the extension may read pods. What the commands print goes to the extension; the activity log keeps the command, never its output.

services.heading: Services in the cluster
services.list: The extension may send requests to these Services through a port forward of Sextant's own:
services.scope: Only in namespaces where it may read and forward to Services. A session token Sextant takes from an answer stays in Sextant until you disconnect; the activity log keeps the method and path, never the query, body or answer.

agentTools.heading: Tools for AI agents
agentTools.list: The extension offers these tools to AI agents in Sextant's MCP server, answered by its backend:
agentTools.scope: Agents get them only after you turn this extension on for agents in the AI agents settings, and never more than their own access allows.
